name: Vernier Metal Fabricating Inc
old_description: Vernier Metal Fabricating Inc. is recognized regionally as an industry leader in precision sheet metal manufacturing. We supply prototypes, production components, and assemblies to a diverse range of customers. With over 50 years experience servicing those diverse customers, we are confident we will exceed your expectations.  Our modern facility is located in Seymour, Connecticut.
about:
Vernier Metal Fabricating Inc. operates from a 12-acre campus in Seymour, Connecticut. The company was founded in 1964 as a two-person sheet metal shop and remains family owned and operated today.

The firm specializes in precision sheet metal fabrication and structural weldments, offering services from design and prototyping through full-scale production. Its facility employs automated equipment, robotics, and advanced manufacturing technologies to handle projects ranging from single-piece prototypes to high-quantity production runs, with entire departments dedicated to each aspect of the manufacturing process.

The company serves a diverse customer base across multiple industries, supplying prototypes, production components, and assemblies. While specific sectors are not named, the business emphasizes its ability to customize processes to fit each customer's specific needs rather than offering a one-size-fits-all service.

Vernier Metal differentiates itself through continuous investment in new technology and equipment to add efficiency, accuracy, and consistency. The company's longevity and family ownership underscore a commitment to quality that has been its stated priority since 1964.
